name: Omapluginstats
author: Marvin Reichmann
description: Views, views per day, copies and hearts for a watchlist of plugins on the Omarchy plugin marketplace, in a panel or as a split-flap ticker on the bar.

barWidget.description: Marketplace engagement for the plugins you watch.

schema.label: Ticker motion without the flip
schema.description: What the ticker does when "Flip the cards" is off in the panel: roll slides the line up and the next one in behind it, none simply changes it.

schema.label: Ticker columns
schema.description: Which numbers the ticker shows beside the name. Leave empty for all of them.

options.label: Views per day
options.description: Lifetime average since the listing went up

schema.label: Ticker name width
schema.description: How many characters of the plugin name the ticker shows before truncating it.

schema.label: Uppercase ticker
schema.description: Show names in capitals, the way a departure board does. Off keeps them as written, at the cost of a longer drum and a slower settle.

schema.label: Ticker cards
schema.description: Draw a card behind each character. Off leaves the seam and the motion on a flat bar.

schema.label: Ticker flap speed (ms)
schema.description: Time for one card to turn. Lower is a faster, noisier board, and it also sets how quickly the board can change plugin at all.

schema.label: Ticker refresh (minutes)
schema.description: How often the numbers are fetched while the ticker is on. Fifteen minutes is both the default and the floor: one request returns every listing on the marketplace.
